bio:
Son of George P. Ransom and Elizabeth Lamoreaux (1808-1893).

Munsell (1880) and Bradsby (1893) both say that George P. Ransom's sawmill of 1815 wore out and that 'his son Chester' built a new one in 1840 ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]). Bradsby's biography of a Mr. Frisbie says that in 1890 Frisbie bought 'the old mill property of Chester Ransom' on Harvey's Creek, which had a fall of eighteen feet, renovated it and added a cider mill ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] H. C. Bradsby, History of Luzerne County (1893), p.589 and Frisbie biography (Jackson Twp.) (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historyofluzerne00brad
[R4-S2] W. W. Munsell, History of Luzerne, Lackawanna and Wyoming Counties (1880), Jackson Twp. (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historyofluzerne00muns
